Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: next steps & sizing call options (ProofPoint Health)

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap so we’re aligned and can lock the sizing session:

- Scope: Dedicated capacity evaluation for your realtime document-embedding and classification pipeline (customer-facing Insight product).
- Primary SLOs you mentioned: median request latency <= 120ms at 99th percentile, sustained concurrent inference for ~200 rps, burst up to 600 rps for short windows.
- Key constraints: customer PII stays in-region, SOC2 evidence required for procurement, and tighter tokenization budget on longer documents (~5–8k tokens typical).

Next step: schedule a 60–75 minute dedicated sizing call (we bring SE + infra; you bring your infra lead and a sample workload owner). During that call we’ll: review workload profile, run a quick throughput/latency checklist, and recommend pool sizing / model variants + KV-caching strategy.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed May 20: 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:15
- Thu May 21: 09:00–10:15 or 16:00–17:15

If none work, share a few windows and I’ll coordinate on our side. I’ve attached a short capacity intake spreadsheet (proofpoint_capacity_form.xlsx) to collect peak qps, avg payload sizes, request concurrency, and retention needs — filling the key rows before the call will let us show a concrete pool recommendation.

Deliverables after the call: sizing recommendation (GPU pool + burst plan), a latency-throughput playbook tailored to your ops model, and an initial cost estimate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking in a time.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
